about: Task S (Soyun Jeong, 2026-11-15): hand-recorded source evidence for all 33 sites in web/data/sites.json. Every 'quote' is checked by pipeline/verify_sites_independent_soyun.py against the text extracted from the source as fetched (whitespace collapsed; in the AGU table the minus sign is a math-font glyph extracted as U+0000 and is restored to U+2212 before matching). lat_text / lon_text are substrings of the quote; the script parses them itself. 'feature' is the geographic claim implied by the record's name / note, and how it is checked.

AGU_ETH.title: Same article, published version PDF in the ETH Zurich Research Collection (doi:10.3929/ethz-c-000797022), CC BY 4.0
AGU_ETH.glyph_note: Table A1 minus signs use code 0 of the embedded font StixTwoMathSymbols (TeX cmsy layout: code 0 = minus; its ToUnicode map starts at code 1 = U+00B7, 2 = U+00D7, 3 = U+2217), so text extraction yields U+0000; the script restores U+2212.
